translation: This method is established for cases where the skin, flesh, sinews, and muscles are injured, but only swollen, hard, and numb, and the bone is not broken. Or because of a fall or misstep, the bone seams have opened and become misaligned, and qi and blood are depressed and stagnant, producing swelling and pain. One should use the pressing and rubbing method, pressing along the channels (經絡) to open the depressed and blocked qi, and rubbing the congested accumulation to disperse the swelling of the congealed stasis; then the affliction can be cured. <ins>Pushing and grasping method (推拿法)</ins> Pushing (推) means pushing with the hand to return it to its former place.
